Shiv Patel — Next.js migration candidate
This repository is a single full-stack Next.js 16.4.3 application at the repository root. Public pages are editable components using Next.js App Router and Link; the dashboard and backend use Next.js route handlers. The separate Laravel backend, React/Vite application, compiled JavaScript loader, Apache deployment files and old archive have been removed from this branch. Earlier versions remain in Git history. Login and submissions still require the database. This mode is limited to development and switches off when any DB connection setting is present; it never conceals a production/database outage.
1. Read the migration plan and restore a private staging copy of your existing MySQL database and media.

4. Review and apply scripts/001-next-support.sql to staging using a database administrator account. Grant the app only the runtime privileges it needs; it does not need CREATE/DROP privileges.
5. Run pnpm audit:data and compare its counts/hashes with the source snapshot. This script reads data; it does not import or modify leg

Appointment Booking Plugin is a WordPress plugin for appointment scheduling, availability checks and booking management.

Features
• Appointment scheduling, availability checks and booking management

Project details
Appointment — Phase 1
A WordPress appointment-management plugin with a React-powered admin workspace and a server-authoritative scheduling engine.Phase 1 scope
The current implementation provides:
- Versioned custom database tables and non-destructive activation migrations
- Administrator capabilities, REST permissions, input validation, and prepared queries
- Categories, services, doctors, doctor-service pricing, working hours, breaks, schedule exceptions, and patients
- Deterministic availability calculation with appointment-conflict exclusion
- Appointment creation, editing, rescheduling, cancellation, filtering, and calendar drag/drop
- Dashboard metrics and date-range activity

- Jump backward or forward by 10 seconds
- Expand and minimize controls

- Optional cat artwork attached to the expanded player

project.description:
Automatic Highlight Generation is a Python video-analysis project for action-based video analysis and generation of selected highlight clips.

Features
• Action-based video analysis and generation of selected highlight clips
• Pose and hand landmark extraction: convert visible body, face and hand positions into numerical keypoints for action analysis.
• Sequence-based action classification: evaluate a moving window of 30 frames and select footage matching the requested action.
• Video summary export and frame comparison: write selected footage to video and compare frame histograms to identify visual differences.

Technology stack
Python, Jupyter Notebook, TensorFlow, Keras, MediaPipe, OpenCV, NumPy
